text:
Keeping Up With Star Rail — Gilgamesh: Your Joy Brings Me Joy | Honkai: Star Rail
"Come," the golden-haired man raised his chin disdainfully. "Take a step toward your king. Or are you just a lowly coward?"
The chimera whimpers as it curls into a trembling ball, its claws extending before retracting again.
"What, can't even bring yourself to take a single step out?" The golden-haired man's piercing gaze burned into the little one before him.
Finally, the chimera closed its eyes, mustered its courage, and took a step forward.
Then, it fell from the sky, landing in the arms of the golden-haired man.
"Hahahaha! Wonderful! Your courage brings me joy!"
"...All you did was make it jump down from the street lamp." A passing security officer shook her head.
Gilgamesh looked askance at her and said to the chimera in his arms, "Pay her no mind. How could she possibly understand your bravery?"

※ The stats displayed in the combat demo is for reference only. Please regard the launch version as final.
